title: Women in 1950s Living Room, Vintage B&W Snapshot 1958
description: A 1958 black and white snapshot depicting a cozy mid-century living room scene with two women seated in armchairs. Behind them, a classic cathode-ray tube television set stands crowned with an arch-shaped clock. The decor features busy botanical drapery, an ornate accent chair, and a coffee table decorated with flowers, exemplifying middle-class American domestic life during the late 1950s.
